label: Company
description: The organization that is filing the SEC regulatory documents. This represents the overall business entity that is subject to SEC reporting requirements.

label: Ticker Symbol
description: The stock ticker symbol that represents the publicly traded company filing the SEC documents.

label: Revenue
description: The total income or sales generated by the company, as reported in the financial statements within the SEC filings.

label: Executive
description: The senior-level managers and officers of the company, whose compensation and other details are required to be disclosed in the SEC filings.

label: Filing Date
description: The date on which the SEC regulatory filing was submitted by the company.

label: Form Type
description: The specific SEC reporting form that the company is filing, such as the 10-K annual report, 10-Q quarterly report, 8-K current report, or Form 4 insider trading report.
